messages.subject: Help with geom_point aesthetics
parts:
Hey all -

I have been getting all sorts of error messages when trying to apply
aesthetics to my scatter plot.

Here's my code

p12 <- qplot(del$Trial, del$X2010_2_3, main = "Minnesota 3 v1.6",
ylab = "Delay Value", xlab = "Trial")+ geom_point(colour = "red") +
theme_bw()



What I want to do is create all points above the value of 1 to have a
different shape and color. So there are 2 shapes and 2 colors for the
points. I get all sorts of error messages like"


Error in grid.pretty(range) : 'range' must be numeric

And......

Error in titles[[i]] : subscript out of bounds

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Help with geom_point aesthetics
parts:
Hi:

Here's an attempt at clairvoyance on my part, but I echo Ista's comments as a general rule.

# Create a toy data frame, and create an indicator Status with label 'Diseased' if y > 1
# and label 'Not diseased' otherwise. The idea here is to create a variable name to use
# as the legend title and whose values correspond to the legend labels *in the data frame*
# rather than post-processing the scales in the ggplot() call.

dd <- data.frame(x = 1:20, y = rnorm(20, 1, 0.5))
dd$Status <- factor(dd$y > 1, labels = c('Not diseased', 'Diseased'))

# Notice that the indicator status is used for both color and shape:
g <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = x, y = y))
g + geom_point(aes(colour = Status, shape = Status), size = 2.5)

HTH,
Dennis
